messages:
Emily Chen: Quick handoff note for the Optimize toolkit pilot with AcmeHealth. Need to lock the default runtime knobs for batching/caching/quant before the canary. Can we do a 15-min sync at 15:30 PT?
Jason Patel: I can join. Quick bullets I want settled: adaptive batch limits, a safe KV cache TTL default, and which quant profiles to expose by default.
María Gómez: Also need the pilot acceptance criteria so the field team knows what to validate. Keep it short.
Ankit Rao: For batching, recommend adaptive batching with max_batch=64, steady-state target 32. Safety fallback: if p99 latency > 300ms over a 5m window, reduce max_batch to 8.
Liu Wei: For KV caching, pilot trace shows many repeated prefixes. Default TTL=30m seems reasonable, with per-route override and a telemetry tag so we can split hit-rate by tenant.
Samir K: Quantization plan: ship INT8-fast as the cost lane but keep FP16 as the quality-safe fallback. Provide an opt-in INT8-deterministic profile for Dedicated/Private customers who care about reproducibility.
Emily Chen: Launch gates I'm proposing:
- Pilot rollout: AcmeHealth only, adaptive batching enabled, KV TTL=30m, INT8-fast enabled but route to FP16 if eval quality delta > 2%.
- GA gate: two weeks stable on pilot, token-cost reduction >= 20% vs baseline, no increase in critical errors, and SLOs met.
Jason Patel: Can we make the fallback automatic per-tenant? If eval alert fires, switch that tenant to FP16 without manual intervention.
María Gómez: Yes, implement an eval-triggered policy that sets fallback_model=FP16 at the routing layer, and make the policy reversible after the issue resolves.
Ankit Rao: Prototype pseudocode:
```
if eval_delta_percent > 2:
  set_tenant_policy(tenant, fallback='fp16')
  notify(#product, @emily)
else:
  no-op
```
We should also log the event to the audit stream.
Liu Wei: Dashboard requirements: batch size histogram, p50/p95/p99 latencies, KV hit rate by tenant, token-cost delta, and eval-concordance metric. Need these panels before canary launch.
Emily Chen: Pilot acceptance checklist for AcmeHealth:
- end-to-end p99 latency <= 350ms
- token cost reduction >= 20% vs their baseline
- eval concordance drop <= 2%
- KV hit rate >= 15% within first week
If any check fails, automatic rollback to previous model + notify ops/product.
Samir K: Note: INT8-fast can be non-deterministic across driver/SM versions. We'll document perf/variance and offer INT8-deterministic (slower) as opt-in for on-prem runs.
Dena (deploy-bot): Canary scheduled: deploy to 5% of tenants at 03:00 UTC, 12h ramp if no regressions.
Jason Patel: Add canary eval hooks: run a small eval after 30m and at 6h. Abort if eval_delta > 1.5% at 30m.
María Gómez: Also add runbook steps: primary on-call, product lead, and field eng contact. Checklist: verify KMS keys and audit logs for AcmeHealth private data flows.
Emily Chen: Action items: (1) Jason + Ankit implement auto-fallback + canary eval jobs. (2) Liu add dashboard panels and tenant tagging. (3) Samir write INT8-deterministic doc with perf numbers. (4) María draft pilot acceptance doc for AcmeHealth. I'll confirm sync at 15:30 PT.
Ankit Rao: I'll open the PR for routing-policy changes and include audit logging.
Jason Patel: Adding the canary job to CI now, will paste PR.
Emily Chen: Thanks team. Keep replies short; we'll finalise wording in the sync. :thumbsup:
